name: In the Name of the Light
summary: Raleigh the Devout in Southshore asks you to confront four named figures. He awaits your report when the work is done.

sections.title: Raleigh's Charge
sections.body: Raleigh the Devout in Southshore sends you against High Inquisitor Whitemane, Scarlet Commander Mograine, Herod, the Scarlet Champion and Houndmaster Loksey. When you have faced them, Raleigh awaits your report.

faq.q: Who asks me to do this?
faq.answer: Raleigh the Devout in Southshore asks you to confront four named figures and report back to him.

faq.q: Who am I supposed to face?
faq.answer: The named figures are High Inquisitor Whitemane, Scarlet Commander Mograine, Herod, the Scarlet Champion and Houndmaster Loksey.
Report back to Raleigh the Devout in Southshore.

attribution: In-game quest text: In the Name of the Light
